task_description: Build PokeOps, a premium zero-dependency multi-user SaaS web app for Pokemon TCG sellers that turns physical card inventory into organized, priced, sellable marketplace inventory. Core loop: Scan -> Identify -> Value -> Single/Bulk -> Listing -> Sell -> Fulfill -> Track Profit. Stack forced by the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (no npm/pip access): TypeScript compiled by the global tsc, Node.js 22 built-ins (node:http, node:sqlite, node:crypto, node:test), vanilla-TS/server-rendered frontend, hand-drawn SVG charts. All AI/pricing/marketplace layers are modular interfaces with deterministic MOCK implementations so real CV/eBay/price/LLM integrations (P2) can drop in later without UI changes. Delivers P0 in full, P1 where coherent, P2 stubbed. Seeded, is_demo-flagged demo data throughout.

verification.summary: npm run build (tsc) clean; npm test = 119/119 node:test cases pass across 25 test files. Test quality confirmed by reading behavioral suites (e.g. profitService.test.ts, mockClassificationService.test.ts): they run real repositories/services against migrated in-memory SQLite and assert exact computed outputs + state transitions, and would fail if the implementation were reverted. Live server smoke: reseeded demo DB, logged in as demo@pokeops.local, all 12 core pages (/dashboard /inventory /singles /bulk /scan /listings /orders /analytics /pricing /settings /rips and / redirect) return expected 200/302, /api/assistant answers from real aggregates, /export/inventory.csv streams rows. No Dockerfile in the project and network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, so docker_build is skipped.
